very pleased so far with the service at High Oak Surgery. I recently requested a private letter to use as proof of address, and they were absolutely outstanding in terms of speed—10 out of 10. When my bank pointed out that some details were missing, the surgery promptly revised the letter at no extra cost and provided the updated version the same day.

The reception staff are incredibly helpful and friendly. Booking consultations has been easy, and they've always managed to find appointments that fit around my busy work schedule. On one occasion, when a nurse consultation had to be rescheduled, they contacted me immediately to rebook it.

The doctor I saw today was truly attentive, listened carefully to my concerns, and arranged the blood tests I had anticipated.

Overall, I’m very happy I chose High Oak Surgery as my practice. The experience has been consistently
